text: Elkem completed the sale of most of its Silicones division to China's Bluestar on 30 April 2026, settled by redeeming all of Bluestar's 338,338,536 shares (52.9%) in Elkem; Bluestar is no longer a shareholder, and Elkem's minority investors assumed 100% control of the listed company.
short: Elkem's former 52.9% owner, China's Bluestar, left in April 2026.

source.name: Elkem: Elkem has sold majority of Silicones division to Bluestar
source.quote: Transaction settled through redemption of Bluestar’s 338,338,536 shares (52.9%) in Elkem. No cash payments by Elkem nor Bluestar as settlement Minority investors assumed 100% control of Elkem (listed)

additionalSources.name: European Rubber Journal: Elkem completes Silicones sale to Bluestar
additionalSources.quote: the transaction announced in February had been completed, alongside the redemption of all of Bluestar’s 338,338,536 shares in Elkem. As a result, Bluestar is no longer a shareholder in the group.
